unit.unitinstructions:
👤 Memphis Psychology People

This tutor includes 39 portraits of faculty and staff connected to the Memphis psychology community.

  • What you will do: Each card shows a face, and you type the matching full name from memory.
  • Timing: Study and drill screens last about 10 seconds, review screens last about 5 seconds, and correct confirmations flash for about 0.5 seconds.
  • How it works: Immediate feedback follows every response, and optional audio feedback can reinforce the correct name aloud.
  • Why it helps: Adaptive scheduling repeats unfamiliar people more often and spaces out the names you already know, making department navigation easier and more natural.

Focus on distinctive facial features and full-name spelling, then begin when you are ready.
